text:
Leah: Quick async — can owners confirm licensing + perf status for new open model polaris9b so we can finalize catalog entry?
Omar: Legal update — got an initial CLA, one item flagged about dataset attribution. I pinged the upstream maintainer, waiting on reply. ETA tomorrow morning.
Jess: Infra: polaris9b loads and runs on staging, but we see sporadic OOM on batch size 8 when sequence >1024. Reproducing now.
Kai: Thanks Jess. Canary perf so far: p95 ~ 240ms (seq128), p99 ~ 680ms (seq512), tokens/s about 70. Cost estimate ~0.9c/token as-is.
Priya: Product note — catalog launch target still Wed. If licensing or infra blocks, we'll soft-launch without polaris9b and add later.
Leah: Important: we need a perf profile (latency, token-cost, embedding compatibility) uploaded to the catalog metadata and owner assigned.
Kai: I'll produce perf JSON and upload: `aws s3 cp perf_report.json s3://redwood-catalog/perf/polaris9b/1727773333.json`
Jess: Kernel note — quantized path degrades accuracy for a small subset of eval prompts. Filed PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/499 — needs runtime review.
Omar: On CLA: maintainer asked for an NDA clause tweak; legal suggested a one-line amendment. I can approve once they accept.
Leah: Action list: (1) Omar: confirm CLA acceptance; (2) Kai: upload perf JSON + add profile to manifest; (3) Jess: validate OOM fix or add autoscaling rule; (4) Priya: update rollout plan. Can we hit these by 10am PT tomorrow?
Kai: Yes for perf JSON, I'll attach metric snapshot and config.
Jess: OOM repro tied to mem fragmentation — working on a patch, ETA 6hrs. Will post a short diff.
Priya: I'll mark polaris9b as "gate: infra/license" in the rollout sheet and notify docs to hold content until cleared.
Leah: Small ask — include a short sample prompt + expected token lengths in the manifest so model pages show realistic cost numbers.
Kai: Will add sample prompts to manifest.
ops-bot: Reminder: catalog-launch-review meeting at 9am PT tomorrow — agenda pinned in #eng-ml.
Leah: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker sooner drop a DM and @leah here. :thumbsup:
